items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. This flaw, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler' by Sansec, was actively exploited in the wild starting September 4, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Magento vendor Fishpig hacked, backdoors added
items.summary: Sansec reported that Fishpig, a vendor of popular Magento-Wordpress integrations, was hacked, leading to malware injection in Fishpig software and control of Fishpig servers. This constitutes a supply chain attack affecting Magento users.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing critical and important vulnerabilities. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications emerged that threat actors were attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Improper Encoding
items.summary: A critical RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction. The flaw is network-exploitable and requires no authentication.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.
